integrity: Integer-only determinant certificates, explicit cochains and full mathematical proof supplied; finite tests are not substituted for infinite-parameter proof. Independent scientific audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact integral first homology only for rook boards with both dimensions >=3. No claim about fundamental-group presentation, integral higher homology, or full homotopy types. Three finite determinant witnesses are replayable; the all-parameter theorem depends on the proved connected-link induction. Obscure earlier equivalent work remains a bibliographic possibility.
title: A sharp integral first-homology transition for rectangular rook neighborhood complexes
